## Overview & Yield Underwriting
TL;DR: DeFi Garden is a quantitative yield intelligence engine and goal-based savings planner. Every pool clears strict trust rails ($100K TVL floor, 1000% APY sanity cap). We evaluate yield quality across four pillars (stability, fee sustainability, depositor stickiness, liquidity depth) and maintain an empirical, multi-run 14-day forward forecast track record publicly benchmarked against a naive "no-change" baseline.
- Public forecast evaluation scorecard: https://www.defi.garden/forecast-accuracy
- Verified scored pools directory: https://www.defi.garden/pools

## Homepage
TL;DR: https://www.defi.garden/ is the predictive underwriting landing — a DeFi Score card, 14-day forecast, and live rates hero. /plan.html (and planner params) reach the goal-first Garden Planner; parameterized URLs (?token=, ?chain=, ?pool=) reach the yield analytics app.
- https://www.defi.garden/

## Garden Planner
TL;DR: A goal-first savings planner for people who think in monthly deposits and life goals, not APY or pools — lives at /plan.html, reached from the underwriting landing at the site root.
- Entry point (bare path, always the planner): https://www.defi.garden/plan.html
- Example filled plans, real presets carrying no invented numbers: https://www.defi.garden/?preset=tomoko and https://www.defi.garden/?preset=kevin
- GROWTH: long-horizon goals like retirement or a home — projects future value from steady monthly deposits.
- TARGET: a specific item to buy — projects time-to-item from monthly deposits and the live rate.
- SUBSCRIPTION: the "forever number" — the capital whose yield alone covers a recurring bill, indefinitely.
- Forever number formula: forever number = annual bill ÷ blended rate. No projected dollar figure is published here — a plan's own inputs determine the real number.
- Median APY across the 5865 pools clearing our published rails (TVL ≥ $100K, APY ≤ 1000%): 4.0% on the date above.
- A plan's own rate is computed over a different set: the planner picks a small, temperament-filtered selection of pools (the default pace is stablecoin lending/staking only) and blends those, so the rate a plan shows will differ from this market-wide median.

## Predictive Underwriting & DeFi Score
TL;DR: A yield-quality score (DeFi Score 0-100: stability, fee sustainability, depositor stickiness, exit liquidity) and an experimental 14-day forward yield forecast for 7,400+ liquidity venues across 30+ chains, updated daily. The score is not a smart-contract or exploit safety audit.
- Methodology: 4 objective pillars — Yield Stability (35%), Fee Sustainability (25%), Capital Stickiness (25%), and Liquidity Depth (15%).
- Experimental 14-day forecast bands: probabilistic p10/p50/p90 yield bands; not yet shown to be more accurate than assuming today's rate holds.
- Verified rails: pools below $100K TVL or with total APY > 1000% are strictly disqualified.

- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://www.defi.garden/mcp
- MCP tool: find_pools
- MCP tool: get_pool
- MCP tool: get_pool_score
- MCP tool: forever_number
- MCP tool: explain_rails
- Trust rails: minimum TVL $100K; maximum total APY 1000%.
